output.reason: [ev-d55f4ac0a53f] shows that in chart 0.16.0, v1beta1 of clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io is no longer the storage version (spec.versions[name=v1beta1].storage changes from true to false). The change text says existing objects stay stored as v1beta1 until they are rewritten and status.storedVersions is updated. So the environments at risk are the ones whose CRD status.storedVersions still lists v1beta1. The proposed condition (ClusterSecretStore of any version in use, plus a from-version below 0.16.0) is too broad, because it flags clusters that are already migrated or whose objects are already stored as v1. It is also too narrow, because it misses clusters already on 0.16.0 or later that still have v1beta1 in storedVersions. The canonical CRD storedVersions shape expresses the exact state.

correction.statement: The storage version of clustersecretstores.external-secrets.io moves from v1beta1 to v1 (chart 0.15.0 → 0.16.0). Exposed: clusters where the CRD's status.storedVersions still lists v1beta1. Their objects must be rewritten and storedVersions updated before a later release removes v1beta1.
